name: Sessions!! ---Shinjitsu Kirai no Tantei wa,
source:
This is a detective story... without a mystery. 

Because the stupid boring world we live in is just dirt beneath our feet. 

This is a detective story... where a laughing stock of a man hates reality. 

But reality is absurd, too. 

Homewreckers and cheats and yakuza and lawyers, even priests and gods get pulled into a decided unrealistic tale. 

Definitely have a look! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120973.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个侦探故事……没有任何谜团。

因为我们生活的这个愚蠢无聊的世界只是我们脚下的泥土。

这是一个侦探故事……一个笑柄的男人讨厌现实。

但现实也是荒谬的。

家庭破坏者、骗子、黑帮和律师，甚至牧师和神都被卷入了一个不切实际的故事。

一定要看看！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120973.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
